blocks.text: A school project needs research. AI can be your guide – helping you ask the right questions and find the way to the answers.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: Choose a topic and narrow it down (not "Space", but "How astronauts eat in space").
Ask the AI for 5 questions your project should answer.
For each question, find the answer in books or reliable websites.
Write down your sources: the book title or the website name.
At the end, ask the AI to help you put everything in a logical order.

blocks.text: I'm 13 and doing a project on how astronauts eat in space. Suggest 5 questions my project should answer and, for each, where to look for a reliable answer.
AI sometimes makes up sources and links! Always check that the book or website really exists.
If you're working in a group, AI can help you split the tasks: who researches what, who makes the slides, who presents.
